abilities.text: After an Event card played with an Event die has fully resolved, if Gandalf is the Guide, you may draw one card from the matching deck. Finish all battles and decisions from that event first; Gandalf may have become Guide during the action.

abilities.title: Emissary from the West
abilities.text: Outside the Fellowship, or after being eliminated, Gandalf the Grey may become Gandalf the White by spending a Will of the West die once a Minion other than the Balrog, Gothmog, the Witch-king — Chief of the Ringwraiths, or any Dark Chieftain has entered play. Replace a surviving Grey in his region; otherwise enter in Fangorn or an unconquered Elven Stronghold, even under siege.
abilities.source: BASE · Gandalf the Grey 4/11 (Second Edition); LORDS p. 6; KINGS p. 14

abilities.title: Guide
abilities.text: While Strider is the Guide, you may spend any available Action die to hide a revealed Fellowship.

abilities.title: Captain of the West

abilities.title: Heir to Isildur
abilities.text: Outside the Fellowship, Strider may become Aragorn by spending a Will of the West die in unconquered Minas Tirith, Dol Amroth or Pelargir. Replace his card while keeping the same figure and location.

abilities.title: Guide
abilities.text: When the Fellowship takes at least 1 Hunt damage, you may separate this Guide to reduce that damage by 1. Choose the new Guide before resolving the remaining damage. Separation on the Mordor Track removes the Hobbit from play. This cannot reduce damage that must be taken entirely as Corruption.

abilities.title: Take Them Alive!
abilities.text: If eliminated while in the Fellowship, this Hobbit immediately returns to play as a separated Companion. This ability does not apply on the Mordor Track.

abilities.title: Shadowfax
abilities.text: Gandalf may move up to 4 regions when moving alone or with exactly one Hobbit. With a larger group, use normal Companion movement. His level remains 3 for other purposes.
abilities.sourceDocument: BASE · Gandalf the White 8/11 (Second Edition); T20

abilities.title: The White Rider
abilities.text: At the start of a battle, after any Stronghold shelter decision and before Combat cards, you may forfeit Gandalf’s Leadership to cancel the Leadership of all Nazgûl, including the Witch-king, for the entire battle. Their presence and other abilities are unchanged.
abilities.sourceDocument: BASE · Gandalf the White 8/11 (Second Edition); T20

abilities.title: Captain of the West
abilities.text: While participating in a battle, add 1 to the Combat Strength of the Free Peoples army, up to the limit of 5 Combat dice.

abilities.title: Guide
abilities.text: Gollum joins the Fellowship and becomes its Guide when no Companions remain. He is not a Companion.

abilities.title: Guide · Unseen path
abilities.text: While Gollum is Guide, ignore the Reveal symbol on standard numbered Hunt tiles. Eye tiles and special Hunt tiles retain their normal effects.

abilities.title: Guide · Reveal
abilities.text: If the Fellowship is hidden and is not already required to reveal, you may reveal it in a legal destination to reduce Hunt damage by 1, to a minimum of 0. The usual restrictions on revealing the Fellowship still apply. This cannot reduce damage that must be taken entirely as Corruption.

abilities.title: Master of the Precious
abilities.text: When all Companions have left the Fellowship or been eliminated, add Gollum as its Guide.

abilities.title: Bound to Orthanc
abilities.text: Saruman cannot leave Orthanc, including with an army, during retreat or when advancing after combat. He may still lead an attack from Orthanc.

abilities.title: The Voice of Saruman
abilities.text: While Saruman is in Shadow-controlled Orthanc and is not under siege, spend a Muster die to recruit one Isengard Regular in each available unconquered Isengard Settlement, or replace two Isengard Regulars in Orthanc with Elites. Use available reserves and follow normal recruitment and stacking restrictions; a shortage permits only the replacements possible.

abilities.title: Servants of the White Hand
abilities.text: While Saruman is in play, every Isengard Elite also counts as a Leader for movement and combat. It remains a single army unit.

cards.source: BASE · The Mouth of Sauron 2/3 (Second Edition); T20

abilities.title: Messenger of the Dark Tower
abilities.text: Once per turn, you may use a Muster die as an Army die: move up to two armies, make an attack or play an Army Event card. Spend the selected die as the cost of that action.
abilities.source: BASE · The Mouth of Sauron 2/3 (Second Edition)
abilities.sourceDocument: BASE · The Mouth of Sauron 2/3 (Second Edition); T20

abilities.title: Terror on entering play
abilities.text: When the Witch-king enters play, activate all Free Peoples Nations.

abilities.title: Sorcerer
abilities.text: After the first combat round resolves, if the Witch-king is still participating and you played a Combat card in that round, you may draw one card from the matching deck. A cancelled Combat card still counts as played. Finish any round continuation or retreat decisions before drawing.

abilities.title: Vilya
abilities.text: After you finish an action, you may give Vilya to the Shadow to keep the Action die you used available (not a Will of the West). A kept Fellowship movement die does not go to the Hunt Box.

abilities.title: Household of Elrond
abilities.text: Each Elven Elite in Elrond’s region also counts as a Leader for all combat purposes, but not for movement.

abilities.title: Combat-card level
abilities.text: Treat Elrond as level 3 when resolving Combat card effects. His normal level remains 0.

abilities.title: Bound to Rivendell
abilities.text: Elrond cannot leave Rivendell, even with an army. Remove him from play if the Shadow conquers Rivendell.

abilities.title: Nenya
abilities.text: When a standard Eye Hunt tile is drawn, you may give Nenya to the Shadow to cancel it and draw another tile. The cancelled Eye is removed from the game.

abilities.title: Valour of the Elven People
abilities.text: You may recruit in Lórien even while it is under siege.

abilities.title: Combat-card level
abilities.text: Treat Galadriel as level 3 when resolving Combat card effects. Her normal level remains 0.

abilities.title: Bound to Lórien
abilities.text: Galadriel cannot leave Lórien, even with an army. Remove her from play if the Shadow conquers Lórien.

abilities.title: Narya
abilities.text: While Gandalf is outside the Fellowship in an unconquered Free Peoples Settlement, give Narya to the Shadow and spend any Action die to activate that Settlement’s Nation and move it straight to At War.

abilities.title: Guide · Narya die
abilities.text: At Recover, if Gandalf is Guide and you recover a Fellowship movement die from the Hunt Box, add the Narya die to your Action dice. If he is the starting Guide, add it in turn 1.

abilities.title: Emissary from the West
abilities.text: While Gandalf is outside the Fellowship or eliminated, you may spend a Will of the West die to replace him with Gandalf the White once a Minion has entered play. The Balrog, Gothmog, the Chief of the Ringwraiths and Dark Chieftains do not count.
abilities.source: LORDS · LM 3/10; pp. 19–20; LORDS p. 6; KINGS p. 14
abilities.sourceDocument: LORDS · LM 3/10; pp. 19–20; T25; LORDS p. 6; T25

abilities.title: Guide
abilities.text: When a Sméagol tile is drawn, Hunt damage is 0 and the tile leaves the game; the first one brings Sméagol in as the Guide. Mithril Coat and Sting cannot stop this. If Gollum entered first, discard the tile and draw another.

abilities.title: Level X
abilities.text: Sméagol’s level equals the highest level among the other Companions in the Fellowship. He counts as a Companion for the Hunt Box dice limit and may be taken as a Hunt casualty, but is not Gollum for card effects.

abilities.title: Departure
abilities.text: Sméagol leaves if he separates, is eliminated or the Fellowship is declared in an unconquered Free Peoples City or Stronghold; We Shall Get It then enters play. If he is ever the only Companion, Gollum replaces him instead. Later Sméagol tiles are discarded and another tile is drawn.
abilities.source: LORDS · LM 4/10; pp. 21–22; LORDS FAQ 1.2 p. 3
abilities.sourceDocument: LORDS · LM 4/10; pp. 21–22; T25; LORDS FAQ 1.2 p. 3

abilities.title: Fire and Shadow
abilities.text: When the Fellowship is declared or revealed and moves into, out of or through the Balrog’s region, or stays in it, draw an additional Hunt tile, ignoring Reveal. An Eye eliminates the Balrog and the Guide (with Gollum as Guide, the Eye is discarded instead).

abilities.title: Flame of Udûn
abilities.text: While participating in a battle, the Balrog adds 2 to the Combat Strength of the Shadow army, up to the limit of 5 Combat dice.

abilities.title: Activation
abilities.text: A Use Balrog result or A Balrog is Come! activates the Balrog (level 2); after that, each Use Balrog result moves or attacks with his army, or moves him alone. The Free Peoples may deactivate him with a Will of the West, or a Character die if Gandalf is in his region; outside Moria he is eliminated.

abilities.title: Gandalf the White entry
abilities.text: The Balrog does not count as a Minion for bringing Gandalf the White into play.

abilities.title: Fling Them into the Fray
abilities.text: While Gothmog is with a Shadow army in a free region, spend a Muster die to recruit one Sauron Regular there or replace one Sauron Regular there with an Elite. A region where his army besieges a Stronghold counts as free.

abilities.title: Gandalf the White entry
abilities.text: Gothmog does not count as a Minion for bringing Gandalf the White into play.

abilities.title: Evil Knowledge
abilities.text: While the Mouth of Sauron is with a besieging army, you may continue the siege battle for one more round without downgrading an Elite. Once per action.

abilities.title: Great Sorcery
abilities.text: Once per turn, while the Mouth of Sauron is with a Shadow army, you may use a Muster die as a Character die to move or attack with that army.

abilities.title: Spear of Terror
abilities.text: When you play a Character Event card while the Witch-king is in the Fellowship’s region, you may immediately draw a Character Event card. With The Palantír of Orthanc in play, draw only one card in total.

abilities.title: He Sees, He Knows
abilities.text: When the Fellowship is declared in a region without an unconquered Free Peoples Stronghold, you may move the Witch-king there at once, without spending an action.

abilities.title: Gandalf the White entry
abilities.text: The Chief of the Ringwraiths does not count as a Minion for bringing Gandalf the White into play.

abilities.title: Lord of the Bats
abilities.text: When the Shadow of Mirkwood is in a battle, before the reveal you may give up your Combat card’s effect and his Leadership: +1 to your Leader re-roll at initiative 4. With Swarm of Bats, also cancel the Free Peoples card at initiative 0.
abilities.sourceDocument: docs/sources/kings-character-index.json (kings.character.shadow-of-mirkwood), card front KM 2/3; KINGS pp. 7,14,15

abilities.title: Dark Chieftain
abilities.text: A Minion for all rules and cards, except Gandalf the White’s entry condition; he moves like a non-flying Minion. While a Dark Chieftain is in play, Shadow has one shared Ruler die, from the next Recover.
abilities.sourceDocument: docs/sources/kings-character-index.json (kings.character.shadow-of-mirkwood), card front KM 2/3; KINGS pp. 7,14,15

abilities.title: I Command
abilities.text: When Uglúk is in a battle, before the reveal you may give up your Combat card’s effect: at initiative 3, both armies get +1 to their Combat roll and Leader re-roll (only Shadow if the card is Desperate Battle).
abilities.sourceDocument: docs/sources/kings-character-index.json (kings.character.ugluk), card front KM 3/3; KINGS pp. 7,14,15

abilities.title: We March Day and Night
abilities.text: While Uglúk is in or adjacent to the Fellowship’s region, even if it is hidden, each Hunt die the Shadow re-rolls gets +1; the first Hunt roll does not.
abilities.sourceDocument: docs/sources/kings-character-index.json (kings.character.ugluk), card front KM 3/3; KINGS pp. 7,14,15

abilities.title: Captain of the West
abilities.text: When Gimli takes part in a battle, add 1 to the Free Peoples army’s Combat Strength (at most five Combat dice).
abilities.source: FATE Collector’s Edition pp.45–46; WOTR018 rules, Lords paragraph; LORDS pp.30–31 and FAQ 1.2 p.3 · 1/11 FE

abilities.title: Dwarf of Renown
abilities.text: While Gimli is in the Iron Hills or Ered Luin, even if the Shadow controls it, you may spend any Action die to move the Dwarves one step toward war.

abilities.title: Guide
abilities.text: When a Hunt tile is drawn while Gimli is the Guide, you may separate him to reduce its damage by 1 (minimum 0), unless that damage must be taken as Corruption.
abilities.source: FATE Collector’s Edition pp.45–46; WOTR018 rules, Lords paragraph; LORDS pp.30–31 and FAQ 1.2 p.3 · LM 6/10 FE

abilities.title: Dwarven Champion
abilities.text: When Gimli takes part in a battle in a Dwarven region (not Erebor), attacking or defending, add 1 to the Free Peoples army’s Combat Strength (at most five Combat dice).
abilities.source: FATE Collector’s Edition pp.45–46; WOTR018 rules, Lords paragraph; LORDS pp.30–31 and FAQ 1.2 p.3 · LM 6/10 FE

abilities.title: Messenger of Elrond
abilities.text: While Gimli is in the Iron Hills or Ered Luin, even if the Shadow controls it, you may spend any Action die to activate the Dwarves and move them one step toward war.

abilities.title: Movement level
abilities.text: Gimli moves as Level 2 but is Level 1 for everything else, such as Hunt casualties. He has no nation icon and may start in the Iron Hills or Ered Luin.
abilities.source: FATE Collector’s Edition pp.45–46; WOTR018 rules, Lords paragraph; LORDS pp.30–31 and FAQ 1.2 p.3 · LM 6/10 FE
